notes: Auto mode finds Proton's buttons reliably now
patch_notes:
Auto mode is more patient and more honest: it keeps scanning Proton's window until the buttons actually appear (Proton may still be loading), accepts Proton's buttons even when Windows reports them as a different control type, and if a click ever fails it now lists the buttons it did see, so the cause is visible.
A late auto-mode result is no longer reported as a failure when the job was already done — for example when you clicked Disconnect yourself first.
